content:
Elena (PM): Quick sync — I sketched a minimal GA operability gate. Main buckets: SLA, docs, support routing/runbooks, monitoring & alerts, pricing floor. Need owners and any must-not-ship items.

Jonah (Eng): For SLA, can we commit to 99.9% for Dedicated and 99.5% for Hosted initially? Latency SLOs — suggest p95 <= 200ms for 32-token generation (small chat). 50ms p95 is unrealistic on day 1.

Samir (SRE): 99.9% for Dedicated ok. Hosted 99.5 makes sense unless autoscale is nailed. We need automated canary + a region failover drill in CI before GA. Also add a synthetic test that covers cold-start KV-cache behavior.

Maya (Product Ops): Docs: quickstart + GA expectations page + migration notes for pilot customers. I'll own drafts and example configs. Support: propose business-hours SL1 coverage, on-call for SEV1s. We should avoid promising 24/7 L1 for GA.

Elena (PM): Good calls. Proposing acceptance checklist (owners inline) — speak now or we lock for shiproom sync. @Jonah @Samir please confirm technical blockers.

Jonah (Eng): I can take autoscale smoke tests and canary runner. PR with smoke harness by Wed. Can't promise regional failover automation alone — need SRE help for draining/traffic tests.

Samir (SRE): I'll add the failover job and the KV cold-start synthetic. Also will author the runbook for degraded-model fallback (include model-variant routing rules).

Maya (Product Ops): I'll draft docs, customer-facing 'what changes' note, and a short pricing FAQ paragraph (what GA pricing means vs pilot). Need a pricing owner to confirm numbers.

Elena (PM): Pricing owner — @Jonah? Or do we need FinOps? We should not gate GA on final enterprise tiers but need a documented floor.

Jonah (Eng): I'll coordinate with FinOps, but FinOps needs final numbers. I can own the technical side (metering hooks, example quotas).

release-bot: Created ticket PROD-4321 for canary automation and PROD-4322 for regional-drill (assignee: Samir). :white_check_mark:

Elena (PM): Here's the acceptance snippet I'm proposing — please react with :thumbsup: if OK, or call out an absolute blocker.

```
GA Operability Acceptance (minimal):
- SLA: Dedicated 99.9%, Hosted 99.5% (owner: Elena)
- Latency SLO: p95 <= 200ms for 32-token gen on default model families (owner: Jonah)
- Monitoring: Synthetic canaries (latency + correctness) and alerting for p99 latency/backpressure (owner: Samir)
- Runbooks: SEV1/SEV2 playbooks + fallback policies documented (owner: Samir)
- Docs: Quickstart, Migration notes, GA expectations page, Pricing FAQ (owner: Maya)
- Support: Business-hours triage + on-call for SEV1s; escalation path documented (owner: Maya)
- Pricing: Published floor for GA, FinOps review in PR (owner: Jonah/FinOps)
```

Samir (SRE): Blocking items to surface: autoscale burst capacity validation, model-variant fallback tested under load. Otherwise OK.

Jonah (Eng): OK from infra side pending smoke harness PR.

Maya (Product Ops): I'll have docs drafts by Fri EOD.

Elena (PM): Great — I'll lock this as the GA operability gate for shiproom unless anyone raises a blocker by EOD. Thanks all.
